CustomerAddressUpdate.title: CustomerAddressUpdate
CustomerAddressUpdate.description: Payload for PUT /customers/me/addresses/{id}. All fields optional.

CustomerUpdate.title: CustomerUpdate
CustomerUpdate.description:
Payload for PUT /customers/me. All fields optional (partial update). Email is
intentionally not updatable here — changing email would require re-verification,
out of scope for this phase.

HotelGuestCreate.title: HotelGuestCreate
HotelGuestCreate.description: Payload for POST /customers/guests — created by staff, no login required.

HotelGuestUpdate.title: HotelGuestUpdate
HotelGuestUpdate.description: Payload for PUT /customers/guests/{id}. All fields optional.

InventoryItemUpdate.title: InventoryItemUpdate
InventoryItemUpdate.description: Payload for PUT /inventory/items/{id}. All fields optional.

InviteStaffRequest.title: InviteStaffRequest
InviteStaffRequest.description: Payload for POST /iam/staff (creates an inactive account + sends invite email).

PaymentConfirmRequest.title: PaymentConfirmRequest
PaymentConfirmRequest.description:
Payload for POST /payments/{id}/confirm — simulates the gateway outcome.

This is a MOCK gateway (Phase 6 scope, demo/test mode) — `simulate_outcome`
lets the caller (or a test) choose whether the simulated confirmation succeeds
or fails, since there is no real payment processor behind this endpoint.

PaymentCreateRequest.title: PaymentCreateRequest
PaymentCreateRequest.description:
Payload for POST /payments/intents — creates a pending payment against an
arbitrary reference_type/reference_id.

RefundRequestCreate.title: RefundRequestCreate
RefundRequestCreate.description:
Payload for POST /payments/{payment_id}/refund-requests. payment_id itself
comes from the URL path, not the body.

RefundRequestReject.title: RefundRequestReject
RefundRequestReject.description:
Payload for POST /admin/refund-requests/{request_id}/reject. A reason is
required when rejecting — this is the one place review_reason is mandatory.

StaffUserUpdate.title: StaffUserUpdate
StaffUserUpdate.description: Payload for PUT /iam/staff/{id}. All fields optional (partial update).

StockAdjustRequest.title: StockAdjustRequest
StockAdjustRequest.description:
Payload for POST /inventory/stock/{item_id}/adjust — a manual, audited
stock movement. Positive quantity_delta increments, negative decrements.

SupplierUpdate.title: SupplierUpdate
SupplierUpdate.description: Payload for PUT /inventory/suppliers/{id}. All fields optional.

WebhookEventRequest.title: WebhookEventRequest
WebhookEventRequest.description: Payload for POST /payments/webhook — a simulated gateway event.
